verdict.rationale: Elicit documents a programmatic REST API (v2), an OpenAPI 3.1 spec, a hosted Scalar reference, and an MCP server. However, no evidence shows official client SDKs, such as Python or JS libraries, that a developer could build against. A raw API and spec are building blocks, not the SDK capability itself, so this applicable axis gets no credit. missing for 10: any official first-party SDK/client library, SDK docs, install instructions, and independent corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Elicit API lets you access Elicit's research capabilities programmatically
